The rich-breadth data are point-in-time proxy observations with changing constituent membership; canonical broad-alt and large-cap breadth remain unconfirmed.

News context is shadow-only. The sanctions announcement is verified as an event, but market relevance, persistence, novelty relative to earlier context, and any price/flow linkage are not established.
